knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

### Configure environment. Load data.
```{r warning=F}

source(here::here("0-config.R"))

d_gps <- 
  read_csv(here(final_data,"AVENIR_grappe_gps_2023-07-31.csv")) %>%
  rename(lat = median_latitude,
         lon = median_longitude)

grappe_phase_mort <- 
  readRDS(paste0(final_data,"AVENIR_grappe_phase_2023-07-31.rds"))

results_spaMM_districts <- list()

```

### Prep map elements
```{r convert to spatial data}

#-------------------------------
# format grappe data as sf
#-------------------------------
d_sf <- st_as_sf(grappe_gps_mort, 
                 coords = c("lon","lat"), 
                 crs    = 4326) # set coordinate ref system to WGS1984

#-------------------------------
# load administrative boundaries
# downloaded from 
# humanitarian data exchange
# https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-ner?
#-------------------------------
niger_adm0 <- st_read(dsn = paste0(shp_data,"ner_adm00_feb2018/NER_adm00_feb2018.shp"))
niger_adm1 <- st_read(dsn = paste0(shp_data,"ner_adm01_feb2018/NER_adm01_feb2018.shp"))
niger_adm2 <- st_read(dsn = paste0(shp_data,"ner_adm02_feb2018/NER_adm02_feb2018.shp"))

# filter admin level 1 region to just Dosso
niger_adm1 <- niger_adm1 %>%
  # filter(adm_01 %in% c("Dosso","Tahoua"))
  filter(adm_01 %in% c("Dosso")) ## for initial analysis, just doing Dosso

niger_adm2 <- niger_adm2 %>%
  filter(adm_01 %in% c("Dosso","Tahoua"))
  # filter(adm_01 %in% c("Dosso")) ## for initial analysis, just doing Dosso

#---------------------------
# identify the bounding box
# around subdistricts that
# contain the WASHB Bangladesh
# clusters
#---------------------------
b_boxgrid <- st_make_grid(niger_adm1,
                          n    = c(100,100),
                          what = "centers"
                          )

b_boxgrid2 <- st_make_grid(niger_adm2,
                          n    = c(100,100),
                          what = "centers"
                          )

```
